originating_goal: Universal explanation contract: the human prose and the portable JSON must not carry text that displays as something other than what it is. Refuse control, format (bidi override/isolate, zero-width), surrogate and line/paragraph-separator characters in builder input and in validated artifacts. No authority, no runtime change, no schema or artifact-shape change.
collision_boundaries: No change to the explanation schema or artifact shape
Existing refusals unchanged; tab, newline and carriage return remain allowed
